description:
Planning only; implementation belongs to parent session. Source: lib/zaq/engine/channel_history_admin.ex, missed 131,136,149,151,189,281,348,458,483,489. Exclusive test edit path: test/zaq/engine/channel_history_admin_test.exs. No application code, extra test paths, E2E, full suite, or coveralls in this issue.

Functional specification / tests before implementation: Add focused DataCase integration tests to the existing module; exercise the real admin request helper (Engine.Api confidential event with persisted current super_admin) except where deliberately testing the dispatcher fallback; use only valid production boundaries and observable return values, persisted grants/messages, and provider events. Existing setup creates an admin, ordinary user, Alex, enabled Mattermost connector, PersonChannel and captured room transcript. Reuse capture/4, request/2, People.create_person/1, AccountsFixtures, HistoryIngress and Ecto changesets; build only missing transcript/permission/child data inside each test. Keep existing assertions intact.

Per missed line: (131) grant error: create a transcript whose permission coordinate is accepted by grant_resource/1 yet rejected by ResourcePermission.changeset (e.g. blank resource_type via test-local Ecto.Change only if the DB permits that persisted corruption); with active Person and valid strategy assert {:error, :invalid_person} and no manual row. Do not bypass public gate by mocking Permissions.grant. If schema or DB constraints prohibit such a row, mark unreachable from supported persisted transcripts. (136) inactive Person with positive ID and valid transcript: update persisted status through existing People API/changeset, assert :invalid_person and no new grant; also preserve missing Person case. (149) supported room ID (use documented 26-character Mattermost ID), complete provider member snapshot through the actual configured Channels dispatch (no internal Action mocking), assert {:ok, %{members: n}} and exact provider grant/read visibility; if no controllable supported transport is available at this entry point, mark blocked, not synthetic. (151) send malformed refresh input rejected by Jido.Exec output/input validation or an Action error lacking details; assert :membership_refresh_failed only if that response is actually produced. Check unsupported-room structured error first for (150) without assuming wrapper shape. (189) send unknown op, nil or malformed map to ChannelHistoryAdmin.dispatch/1; assert :invalid_request; through Api separately assert authorization remains first, not arbitrary actor escalation. (281) create a valid child thread whose parent lacks the external root message; detail should return root_message: nil on provider unavailability, while still returning authorized replies; if a deterministic real Channels response can be arranged assert confidential channel_room_message event and nil fallback without network. (348) change first non-assistant message history_context to title_style person/person_subject with a nonexistent positive author_person_id and author_name; detail/list title must use persisted name (and subject or No subject); variant with nil name/id uses Person; existing real Person name is the positive control. (458) in sandbox arrange otherwise valid nonlegacy transcript with mismatched persisted provider vs connector provider (only if DB permits), assert detail :not_found and list excludes it; likewise unknown config ID only if FK allows. (483) revoke same manual grant twice; second succeeds idempotently, no grant remains, provider-sourced grant for same Person remains and read stays allowed. (489) Permissions.revoke/3 injects a revoker but ChannelHistoryAdmin calls revoke/2, whose default PermissionRevoker deletes via Repo; normal valid manual rows cannot deterministically yield {:error, changeset}. Do not mutate global mocks, break DB or add test-only seam. Record as unreachable without a production-meaningful injectable revocation failure.

Mocking/isolation: real Repo, People, Permissions, Action and Engine.Api; no Mox for internal modules. Provider calls only if an existing behavior-backed controlled Channels transport seam is already accessible; pattern-match %Zaq.Event{request: ..., opts: ...} and assert response, never blanket-stub NodeRouter. Existing module uses DataCase async: false; sandbox owns records. Avoid Application env/global Mox mutation, sleeps and polling. Use unique IDs and deterministic request/response boundaries. If a genuine external provider fake requires a global replacement, put only those tests in a separate async:false module after obtaining separate path ownership; do not add it to this issue without coordination.

Property assessment: privilege defaults and revocation idempotence are invariants but this scope is fixed admin operation and finite concrete branches; a focused nil/malformed actor negative table and double-revoke example give clearer integration evidence than generated DB cases. If expanding to arbitrary scopes/IDs, use bounded StreamData property with deterministic sandbox and permission non-escalation invariant. No UI journey change, so no new E2E.

Action reuse assessment: not applicable — tests only; no executable operation or Action contract changes. Reuse current ChannelHistoryAdmin dispatch, RefreshChannelHistoryMembership Action, Permissions.grant/revoke and Engine.Api; do not add an agent tool or new Action. Owner stays existing Engine test module. Documentation to update: none unless contract/reachability evidence warrants a separate follow-up.

Validation handoff to parent only: add tests before any production change; run isolated mix test test/zaq/engine/channel_history_admin_test.exs and targeted --cover measurement, then mix q (includes format). Parent owns these and any final gate; do NOT run full suite or coveralls here. Review per-line execution and assert behavior, report blocked branches 131/149/151/458/489 with exact prerequisite/coverage exception rather than forced test-only hooks. No implementation or test execution by planner.
